information_requirement_traceability.description: Live visibility into the location, speed, and status of all active delivery agents and the aggregate capacity of the fleet within the service zone.

business_requirements.name: BR-01: Dynamic Fleet Capacity Management
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall dynamically balance workload across delivery agents and optimize fleet deployment to minimize total delivery time based on live supply availability.
business_requirements.business_objective: To ensure efficient resource utilization and prevent network congestion by matching order demand with real-time agent capacity.
business_requirements.business_value: Optimizes operational efficiency, reduces delivery times, and minimizes fuel consumption by ensuring agents are utilized effectively without overloading the network.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR explicitly states the business purpose is 'To manage network congestion, balance workload across agents, and dynamically adjust delivery expectations or fees based on current supply availability.'

origin.description: Live visibility into the location, speed, and status of all active delivery agents and the aggregate capacity of the fleet within the service zone.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of orders assigned to agents within optimal capacity thresholds
Reduction in average fleet idle time

policies_and_constraints: Capacity metrics must be updated continuously as agents move.
Network data must be consistent across all monitoring systems.
assumptions: GPS data is available with sufficient latency for real-time decision making.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: GPS signal loss or latency causing inaccurate capacity data.
Dependency: Continuous updates from Delivery Partners regarding their current location, speed, and active assignments.

business_requirements.name: BR-02: Real-Time Incident Response and Reassignment
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall automatically reassign orders to nearby agents when a primary agent becomes unavailable due to incidents such as vehicle breakdowns or accidents.
business_requirements.business_objective: To maintain service levels and minimize customer impact by rapidly reacting to disruptions in the delivery network.
business_requirements.business_value: Ensures high reliability of the delivery service, reduces customer complaints, and maintains trust in the platform's ability to fulfill orders.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR supports business decisions for 'Reassigning orders to nearby agents if a primary agent becomes unavailable' and 'Optimizing the overall fleet deployment to minimize total delivery time.' This implies a capability to detect unavailability and trigger reassignment.

origin.description: Live visibility into the location, speed, and status of all active delivery agents and the aggregate capacity of the fleet within the service zone.

success_measures.measure: Time taken to reassign an order after agent failure
Percentage of orders successfully re-routed during incidents

policies_and_constraints: Congestion alerts must be triggered when demand exceeds supply.
Status updates must be timestamped and verifiable.
assumptions: Nearby agents are available to accept reassignments.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Lack of nearby agents during high congestion.
Dependency: Incident Reports alerts for accidents, vehicle issues, or customer complaints.

business_requirements.name: BR-03: Dynamic Delivery Expectation and Fee Adjustment
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall dynamically adjust delivery expectations (e.g., estimated time of arrival) and fees based on current supply availability and network congestion levels.
business_requirements.business_objective: To align customer expectations with actual network capabilities and ensure fair pricing based on real-time operational difficulty.
business_requirements.business_value: Improves customer satisfaction by managing expectations accurately and ensures revenue sustainability by adjusting fees during high-demand or low-supply scenarios.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR states the business purpose includes 'dynamically adjust delivery expectations or fees based on current supply availability.' This requires a business rule to execute these adjustments.

origin.description: Live visibility into the location, speed, and speed of all active delivery agents and the aggregate capacity of the fleet within the service zone.

success_measures.measure: Reduction in customer complaints regarding missed delivery windows
Revenue stability during peak congestion periods

policies_and_constraints: Network status must be shared with all relevant stakeholders.
Agent availability must be monitored to optimize dispatch times.
assumptions: Customers accept dynamic pricing and ETA adjustments.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Customer churn due to unexpected fee increases.
Dependency: Live updates on agent location, speed, and active assignments.

business_requirements.name: BR-04: Network Congestion Monitoring and Alerting
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall monitor network congestion levels and trigger alerts when demand exceeds supply to enable rapid response to incidents.
business_requirements.business_objective: To provide the Platform Operations Center with actionable intelligence to manage network health and prevent service degradation.
business_requirements.business_value: Enables proactive management of service quality, reduces operational risk, and supports strategic decisions regarding fleet expansion or route optimization.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR explicitly lists 'Congestion alerts must be triggered when demand exceeds supply' as a functional rule and states the information is 'Monitored by the Platform Operations Center to manage network congestion.'

origin.description: Live visibility into the location, speed, and status of all active delivery agents and the aggregate capacity of the fleet within the service zone.

success_measures.measure: Latency between congestion detection and alert generation
Percentage of congestion events resolved within SLA

policies_and_constraints: Capacity figures must reflect the current number of active agents.
Status updates must be timestamped and verifiable.
assumptions: Demand and supply data can be accurately compared in real-time.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: False positives in congestion detection leading to unnecessary alerts.
Dependency: Aggregated data from GPS trackers, mobile apps, and manual inputs from Delivery Partners.

business_requirements.name: BR-05: Data Integrity and Validation for Logistics Status
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall validate and synchronize location and speed data with GPS systems to ensure consistency and verifiability across all monitoring systems.
business_requirements.business_objective: To ensure the reliability of the logistics network status data used for decision-making and billing.
business_requirements.business_value: Prevents operational errors, ensures accurate financial transactions, and maintains trust in the platform's data integrity.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR explicitly lists 'Location data must be synchronized with GPS systems' and 'Network data must be consistent across all monitoring systems' as information validation rules.

origin.description: Live visibility into the location, speed, and status of all active delivery agents and the aggregate capacity of the fleet within the service zone.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of data records passing validation checks
Discrepancy rate between reported location and GPS system location

policies_and_constraints: Speed estimates must be consistent with actual travel times.
Network data must be consistent across all monitoring systems.
assumptions: GPS systems provide accurate and timely location data.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Data corruption or synchronization failure leading to incorrect status reporting.
Dependency: Delivery Partners report live location/speed; Platform Operator aggregates this into fleet capacity data.
